name: Edit
description: Performs an exact string replacement in one of the frontend files (frontend.tsx or theme.ts). old_string must match the file's current contents exactly (including whitespace) and must be unique in the file — include surrounding context to disambiguate.

file.description: Which frontend file to edit, e.g. "frontend.tsx"

old_string.description: Exact text to replace; must occur exactly once in the file
